ei.title: 37번 — Exotic Species: Grey vs Red Squirrels
ei.subject: 6월_2024 고1 모의고사
ei.lesson: 37번 — Exotic Species: Grey vs Red Squirrels

fullPassage:
Problems often arise if an exotic species is suddenly introduced to an ecosystem.

(A) The grey had the edge because it can adapt its diet; it is able, for instance, to eat green acorns, while the red can only digest mature acorns. Within the same area of forest, grey squirrels can destroy the food supply before red squirrels even have a bite.

(B) Britain’s red and grey squirrels provide a clear example. When the grey arrived from America in the 1870s, both squirrel species competed for the same food and habitat, which put the native red squirrel populations under pressure.

(C) Greys can also live more densely and in varied habitats, so have survived more easily when woodland has been destroyed. As a result, the red squirrel has come close to extinction in England.

questions.passage: Problems often ①<u>arise</u> if an exotic species is suddenly ②<u>introducing</u> to an ecosystem. The grey had the edge because it can adapt its diet; it is able, for instance, to eat green acorns, while the red can only digest mature acorns. Within the same area of forest, grey squirrels can destroy the food supply before red squirrels even have a bite. Britain’s red and grey squirrels provide a clear example. When the grey arrived from America in the 1870s, both squirrel species ③<u>competed</u> for the same food and habitat, which put the native red squirrel populations under pressure. Greys can also live more densely and in varied habitats, so have ④<u>survived</u> more easily when woodland has been destroyed. As a result, the red squirrel has come close to extinction in England.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ② introducing → introduced: 외래종(species)은 생태계에 '도입되는' 대상이므로 수동태 is introduced가 옳다
det.analysis:
✅ ① arise: 적절 — 주어 Problems(복수)에 맞는 현재형 동사예요.

❌ ② introducing → introduced: 'an exotic species is suddenly ②___'에서 외래종은 사람에 의해 '도입되는' 대상이에요. 그래서 be동사(is) 뒤에는 수동태를 만드는 과거분사 introduced를 써야 해요. introducing(-ing)은 능동이라 '종이 무언가를 도입한다'는 뜻이 되어 어색해요. ←정답

✅ ③ competed: 적절 — 과거의 일이라 과거형 competed가 맞아요.

✅ ④ survived: 적절 — 'have survived'로 현재완료를 이루는 과거분사예요.
det.tip: be동사 + p.p. = 수동태(~되다). is introduced = 도입되다

questions.passage: Problems often arise if an exotic species is suddenly introduced to an ecosystem. The grey ①<u>had</u> the edge because it can adapt its diet; it is able, for instance, to eat green acorns, while the red can only digest mature acorns. Within the same area of forest, grey squirrels can destroy the food supply before red squirrels even have a bite. Britain’s red and grey squirrels provide a clear example. When the grey arrived from America in the 1870s, both squirrel species ②<u>competed</u> for the same food and habitat, which put the native red squirrel populations under pressure. Greys can also ③<u>live</u> more densely and in varied habitats, so have survived more easily when woodland has been ④<u>destroying</u>. As a result, the red squirrel has come close to extinction in England.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ④ destroying → destroyed: 숲(woodland)은 '파괴되는' 대상이므로 완료수동 has been destroyed가 옳다
det.analysis:
✅ ① had: 적절 — 과거의 일이라 과거형 had가 맞아요(had the edge=우위를 점했다).

✅ ② competed: 적절 — 과거형이에요.

✅ ③ live: 적절 — 조동사 can 뒤에는 동사원형 live를 써요.

❌ ④ destroying → destroyed: 'when woodland has been ④___'에서 숲은 '파괴되는' 대상이에요. has been 뒤에는 수동을 만드는 과거분사 destroyed를 써서 '파괴되어 왔다(현재완료 수동)'가 돼요. destroying은 능동이라 어색해요. ←정답
det.tip: have/has been + p.p. = 현재완료 수동(~되어 왔다). has been destroyed = 파괴되어 왔다

questions.passage: Problems often arise if an exotic species is suddenly introduced to an ecosystem. The grey had the edge because it can adapt its diet; it is able, for instance, to eat green acorns, while the red can only digest mature acorns. Within the same area of forest, grey squirrels can destroy the food supply before red squirrels even have a bite. Britain’s red and grey squirrels provide a clear example. When the grey arrived from America in the 1870s, both squirrel species competed for the same food and habitat, ①<u>what</u> put the native red squirrel populations under pressure. Greys can also live more ②<u>densely</u> and in varied habitats, so have ③<u>survived</u> more easily when woodland has been destroyed. As a result, the red squirrel has ④<u>come</u> close to extinction in England.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ① what → which: 콤마 뒤에서 앞 문장 전체를 받아 이어 주는 계속적 용법에는 which를 쓴다(what 불가)
det.analysis:
❌ ① what → which: '~ competed for the same food and habitat, ①___ put the native red squirrel populations under pressure'는 콤마 뒤에서 앞 문장 전체를 받아 '그리고 그것이 ~을 압박했다'로 이어 주는 자리예요. 이런 계속적 용법에는 관계대명사 which를 써요. what은 안에 선행사(대상)를 이미 품고 있어 앞 내용을 받을 수 없으므로 틀려요. ←정답

✅ ② densely: 적절 — 동사 live를 꾸미는 부사예요(밀집하여 살다).

✅ ③ survived: 적절 — 'have survived'의 과거분사예요.

✅ ④ come: 적절 — 'has come'으로 현재완료를 이루는 과거분사예요.
det.tip: 콤마(,) + which = 앞 문장 전체를 받는 계속적 용법. what은 불가

questions.passage: Problems often arise if an exotic species is suddenly introduced to an ecosystem. The grey had the edge because it can adapt its diet; it is able, for instance, to eat green acorns, while the red can only digest mature acorns. Within the same area of forest, grey squirrels can destroy the food supply before red squirrels even have a bite. Britain’s red and grey squirrels provide a clear example. When the grey ①<u>arrived</u> from America in the 1870s, both squirrel species ②<u>competed</u> for the same food and habitat, which put the native red squirrel populations under pressure. Greys can also live more densely and in varied habitats, so ③<u>has survived</u> more easily when woodland has been ④<u>destroyed</u>. As a result, the red squirrel has come close to extinction in England.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ③ has survived → have survived: 주어 Greys(복수)에 맞춰 복수동사 have를 써야 한다
det.analysis:
✅ ① arrived: 적절 — 1870년대의 일이라 과거형 arrived가 맞아요.

✅ ② competed: 적절 — 과거형이에요.

❌ ③ has survived → have survived: 이 문장의 주어는 앞의 Greys(회색 다람쥐들, 복수)예요. 'Greys can also live ~, so ③___ more easily'에서 주어가 복수이므로 has(단수)가 아니라 have를 써야 해요. 주어가 동사에서 멀리 떨어져 있어 헷갈리기 쉬운 부분이에요. ←정답

✅ ④ destroyed: 적절 — 'has been destroyed'의 과거분사예요.
det.tip: 주어-동사 수일치: Greys(복수) → have survived (has 아님)

questions.passage: Problems often arise if an exotic species is suddenly ①<u>introduced</u> to an ecosystem. The grey had the edge because it can adapt its diet; it is able, for instance, to eat green acorns, while the red can only digest mature acorns. Within the same area of forest, grey squirrels can destroy the food supply before red squirrels even have a bite. Britain’s red and grey squirrels provide a clear example. When the grey arrived from America in the 1870s, both squirrel species ②<u>competed</u> for the same food and habitat, which put the ③<u>foreign</u> red squirrel populations under pressure. Greys can also live more densely and in varied habitats, so have ④<u>survived</u> more easily when woodland has been destroyed. As a result, the red squirrel has come close to extinction in England.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ③ foreign(외래의) → native(토종의): 압박을 받은 것은 그 지역 '토종' 붉은 다람쥐 개체군
det.analysis:
✅ ① introduced(도입된): 적절 — 외래종이 생태계에 도입될 때 문제가 생겨요.

✅ ② competed(경쟁했다): 적절 — 두 종이 같은 먹이·서식지를 두고 경쟁해요.

❌ ③ foreign(외래의) → native(토종의): 원문은 '토종(native)' 붉은 다람쥐 개체군이에요. 외래종인 회색 다람쥐 때문에 압박받은 것은 원래 그곳에 살던 '토종' 붉은 다람쥐이므로, '외래의(foreign)'는 정반대라 부적절해요. ←정답

✅ ④ survived(살아남았다): 적절 — 회색 다람쥐가 서식지 파괴에도 더 쉽게 살아남았어요.
det.tip: native(토종의) ↔ foreign(외래의). 위협받은 쪽은 토종 붉은 다람쥐

questions.passage: Problems often arise if an exotic species is suddenly introduced to an ecosystem. The grey had the edge because it can adapt its diet; it is able, for instance, to eat green acorns, while the red can only digest mature acorns. Within the same area of forest, grey squirrels can ①<u>increase</u> the food supply before red squirrels even have a bite. Britain’s red and grey squirrels provide a clear example. When the grey arrived from America in the 1870s, both squirrel species competed for the same food and ②<u>habitat</u>, which put the native red squirrel populations under pressure. Greys can also live more ③<u>densely</u> and in varied habitats, so have survived more easily when woodland has been destroyed. As a result, the red squirrel has come close to ④<u>extinction</u> in England.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ① increase(늘리다) → destroy(없애다): 회색 다람쥐가 붉은 다람쥐가 먹기도 전에 먹이 공급을 '없애 버린다'는 문맥
det.analysis:
❌ ① increase(늘리다) → destroy(없애다): 원문은 '회색 다람쥐가 먹이 공급을 destroy(없앤다)'예요. 붉은 다람쥐가 한 입 먹기도 전에 먹이가 사라져 붉은 다람쥐가 위협받는 흐름이므로, '늘리다(increase)'는 정반대라 부적절해요. ←정답

✅ ② habitat(서식지): 적절 — 같은 먹이와 서식지를 두고 경쟁해요.

✅ ③ densely(밀집하여): 적절 — 회색 다람쥐는 더 밀집해서 살 수 있어요.

✅ ④ extinction(멸종): 적절 — 붉은 다람쥐가 멸종에 가까워졌어요.
det.tip: destroy the food supply = 먹이 공급을 없애다. increase(늘리다)와 반대

questions.passage: Problems often arise if an exotic species is suddenly introduced to an ecosystem. The grey had the edge because it can adapt its diet; it is able, for instance, to eat green acorns, while the red can only digest mature acorns. Within the same area of forest, grey squirrels can destroy the food supply before red squirrels even have a bite. Britain’s red and grey squirrels provide a clear example. When the grey arrived from America in the 1870s, both squirrel species competed for the same food and habitat, which put the native red squirrel populations under pressure. Greys can also live more densely and in varied habitats, so have survived more easily when woodland has been destroyed. As a result, the red squirrel has come close to extinction in England.
questions.stem: 다음 진술이 글의 내용과 일치하면 T, 일치하지 않으면 F를 고르시오: '회색 다람쥐는 붉은 다람쥐와 달리 아직 덜 여문 도토리도 먹을 수 있다.'

det.korean: 원문: it is able ~ to eat green acorns, while the red can only digest mature acorns — 회색은 풋도토리도 먹고 붉은 것은 다 자란 것만 소화
det.analysis:
✅ ① T: 회색 다람쥐는 풋도토리(green acorns)도 먹을 수 있고, 붉은 다람쥐는 다 자란 도토리(mature acorns)만 소화할 수 있다고 했어요. 진술과 일치해요. ←정답

❌ ② F: 원문과 어긋나지 않아요.
det.tip: green acorns=덜 여문 도토리, mature acorns=다 자란 도토리

questions.stem: 다음 진술이 글의 내용과 일치하면 T, 일치하지 않으면 F를 고르시오: '붉은 다람쥐는 1870년대에 아메리카에서 영국으로 건너온 종이다.'

det.korean: 원문: When the grey arrived from America in the 1870s — 1870년대에 아메리카에서 건너온 것은 '회색' 다람쥐
det.analysis:
❌ ① T: 원문과 어긋나요.

✅ ② F: 1870년대에 아메리카에서 건너온 것은 '회색(grey)' 다람쥐예요. 붉은 다람쥐는 원래 영국에 살던 토종(native)이므로, '붉은 다람쥐가 건너왔다'는 진술은 거짓이에요. ←정답
det.tip: the grey arrived from America = 회색 다람쥐가 아메리카에서 건너옴 (붉은 것은 토종)

questions.passage: Problems often arise if an exotic species is suddenly introduced to an ecosystem. questions.stem: 다음 진술이 글의 내용과 일치하면 T, 일치하지 않으면 F를 고르시오: '붉은 다람쥐는 잉글랜드에서 멸종에 가까운 상태에 이르렀다.'

det.korean: 원문: the red squirrel has come close to extinction in England — 붉은 다람쥐가 잉글랜드에서 멸종에 가까워짐
det.analysis:
✅ ① T: 회색 다람쥐와의 경쟁·서식지 파괴로 붉은 다람쥐가 잉글랜드에서 '멸종에 가까워졌다(come close to extinction)'고 했어요. 진술과 일치해요. ←정답

❌ ② F: 원문과 어긋나지 않아요.
det.tip: come close to extinction = 멸종에 가까워지다

questions.passage: Problems often arise if an exotic species is suddenly introduced to an ecosystem. The grey had the edge because it can adapt its diet; it is able, for instance, to eat green acorns, while the red can only digest mature acorns. Within the same area of forest, grey squirrels can destroy the food supply before red squirrels even have a bite. Britain’s red and grey squirrels provide a clear example. When the grey arrived from America in the 1870s, both squirrel species competed for the same food and __________, which put the native red squirrel populations under pressure. Greys can also live more densely and in varied habitats, so have survived more easily when woodland has been destroyed. As a result, the red squirrel has come close to extinction in England.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: competed for the same food and habitat = 같은 먹이와 서식지를 두고 경쟁하다
det.analysis:
빈칸 문장: 'both squirrel species competed for the same food and ___'(두 다람쥐 종은 같은 먹이와 ___을 두고 경쟁했다). 먹이와 함께 다투는 자원이므로 '서식지'가 필요해요.

❌ ① climate(기후): 두 종이 다투어 차지하는 대상으로 어색해요.

❌ ② season(계절): 경쟁 대상이 될 수 없어요.

❌ ③ water(물): 본문은 먹이·서식지 경쟁을 말하지 물은 언급하지 않아요.

✅ ④ habitat(서식지): 먹이와 함께 두 종이 다투는 자원으로 딱 맞아요. ←정답
det.tip: food and habitat = 먹이와 서식지 (두 종이 다투는 자원)

questions.passage: Problems often arise if an exotic species is suddenly introduced to an ecosystem. The grey had the edge because it can adapt its diet; it is able, for instance, to eat green acorns, while the red can only digest mature acorns. Within the same area of forest, grey squirrels can destroy the food supply before red squirrels even have a bite. Britain’s red and grey squirrels provide a clear example. When the grey arrived from America in the 1870s, both squirrel species competed for the same food and habitat, which put the native red squirrel populations under pressure. Greys can also live more densely and in varied habitats, so have survived more easily when woodland has been destroyed. As a result, the red squirrel has come close to __________ in England.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: come close to extinction = 멸종에 가까워지다
det.analysis:
빈칸 문장: 'As a result, the red squirrel has come close to ___ in England'(그 결과 붉은 다람쥐는 잉글랜드에서 ___에 가까워졌다). 경쟁과 서식지 파괴로 붉은 다람쥐가 크게 줄었다는 흐름이라 '멸종'이 필요해요.

❌ ① recovery(회복): 붉은 다람쥐가 위기에 처한 흐름과 정반대예요.

✅ ② extinction(멸종): 붉은 다람쥐 수가 급감해 사라질 위기에 이르렀다는 결과에 맞아요. ←정답

❌ ③ migration(이주): 다른 곳으로 옮겨 갔다는 내용은 본문에 없어요.

❌ ④ balance(균형): 위기라는 부정적 결과와 어울리지 않아요.
det.tip: come close to extinction = 멸종 직전까지 가다

questions.passage: Problems often arise if an exotic species is suddenly introduced to an ecosystem. The grey had the edge because it can adapt its diet; it is able, for instance, to eat green acorns, while the red can only digest mature acorns. Within the same area of forest, grey squirrels can destroy the food supply before red squirrels even have a bite. Britain’s red and grey squirrels provide a clear example. When the grey arrived from America in the 1870s, both squirrel species competed for the same food and habitat, which put the native red squirrel populations under pressure. Greys can also live more densely and in varied habitats, so have survived more easily when woodland has been destroyed. As a result, the red squirrel has come close to extinction in England.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 내용과 일치하는 것은?

det.korean: 원문: Greys can also live more densely and in varied habitats, so have survived more easily
det.analysis:
❌ ① 다 자란 도토리만 먹는 것은 '붉은' 다람쥐예요. 회색은 풋도토리도 먹어요.

❌ ② 1870년대에 아메리카에서 건너온 것은 '회색' 다람쥐예요. 붉은 다람쥐는 토종이에요.

✅ ③ 원문 'Greys ~ live more densely and in varied habitats, so have survived more easily'와 일치해요. ←정답

questions.passage: Problems often arise if an exotic species is suddenly introduced to an ecosystem. The grey had the edge because it can adapt its diet; it is able, for instance, to eat green acorns, while the red can only digest mature acorns. Within the same area of forest, grey squirrels can destroy the food supply before red squirrels even have a bite. Britain’s red and grey squirrels provide a clear example. When the grey arrived from America in the 1870s, both squirrel species competed for the same food and habitat, which put the native red squirrel populations under pressure. Greys can also live more densely and in varied habitats, so have survived more easily when woodland has been destroyed. As a result, the red squirrel has come close to extinction in England.

det.analysis:
'두 다람쥐 종은 ~을 두고 경쟁했다'가 핵심이라 주어부터 놓아요: both(둘 다) + squirrel(다람쥐) + species(종). both는 복수 명사 앞에 와요.

동사는 competed(경쟁했다)예요. '무엇을 두고'는 for로 이어요: for.

무엇을 두고 다투었는가 하면 'the same food and habitat(같은 먹이와 서식지)'예요: the → same → food → and → habitat.

순서대로 이으면 both / squirrel / species / competed / for / the / same / food / and / habitat.
